scope: 6 planned runs; 3 requested models x 2 tasks
raw_hash_semantics: Original embedded report/completion/plan/freeze digests are unchanged. They refer to original local bytes. Use this separate original_sha256/export_sha256 mapping for public byte verification; never treat a transformed report as having its original hash.
redaction_policy: Personal roots and credential connection labels removed recursively. JSON compacted without numerical rounding. Full numeric NPZ files unchanged. Provider endpoint, declared model, settings, token usage and benchmark estimates retained; account billing, credential files, databases and source-page images excluded.
image_policy: Original source-page PNGs are excluded. Logged image hashes/sizes and path placeholders remain. Reproduce source images through the published source downloader; own simulated-paper observation PNGs are included.
environment_failure_preserved: Gemini H102 HTTP 524 retained, with its request/response/error and environment report; not counted as a demonstrated model failure.
rescore_command: python scripts/score_precrease_candidates.py score --task H102 --run examples/model-evidence-v4/gpt/H102 --private data/precrease-hard-v4/private/tasks.json --asset-root .
verification_note: Offline rescoring is a local evidence check only; no API or physics was executed. Re-score each task with its matching task ID and directory.
